WITH cd_filtered AS (
    SELECT cd_demo_sk
    FROM customer_demographics
    WHERE cd_gender = 'F' AND cd_education_status = 'Primary'
),
filtered_customer AS (
    SELECT c_customer_sk
    FROM customer
    WHERE c_birth_month IN (1,3,7,11,10,4)
),
customer_address_filtered AS (
    SELECT ca_address_sk
    FROM customer_address
    WHERE ca_state IN ('AL','MO','TN' ,'GA','MT','IN','CA')
)
SELECT i_item_id, ca_country, ca_state, ca_county, 
       AVG(avg_quantity) AS agg1,
       AVG(avg_list_price) AS agg2,
       AVG(avg_coupon_amt) AS agg3,
       AVG(avg_sales_price) AS agg4,
       AVG(avg_net_profit) AS agg5,
       AVG(c_birth_year) AS agg6,
       AVG(cd_filtered.cd_demo_sk) AS agg7
FROM (
    SELECT 
        i_item_id,
        ca_country,
        ca_state,
        ca_county,
        AVG(cs_quantity) AS avg_quantity,
        AVG(cs_list_price) AS avg_list_price,
        AVG(cs_coupon_amt) AS avg_coupon_amt,
        AVG(cs_sales_price) AS avg_sales_price,
        AVG(cs_net_profit) AS avg_net_profit
    FROM 
        catalog_sales cs
    JOIN 
        cd_filtered cd1 ON cs_bill_cdemo_sk = cd1.cd_demo_sk
    JOIN 
        filtered_customer c ON cs_bill_customer_sk = c.c_customer_sk
    JOIN 
        customer_address ca ON cs_bill_addr_sk = ca.ca_address_sk
    JOIN 
        date_dim d ON cs_sold_date_sk = d.d_date_sk
    JOIN 
        item i ON cs_item_sk = i.i_item_sk
    WHERE 
        d_year = 2001
    GROUP BY 
        i_item_id, ca_country, ca_state, ca_county
) AS pre_agg
GROUP BY ROLLUP (i_item_id, ca_country, ca_state, ca_county)
ORDER BY 
    ca_country, ca_state, ca_county, i_item_id
LIMIT 100
